//! What the greeting domain's `greet` use case promises, in the core's own vocabulary.

use super::errors::GreetError;
use crate::outbound::names::types::Greeting;

/// What `greet` offers its callers.
pub trait GreetUseCase {
    /// Greets the person named.
    ///
    /// # Errors
    ///
    /// `GreetError::Empty` for an empty name, and `GreetError::Names` when the names port refuses it.
    fn greet(&self, name: &'static str) -> Result<Greeting, GreetError>;
}
